t: A web platform for teacher-led writing lessons with AI feedback on student responses.
steps: Find Curipod on its official website.
Ask IT or the privacy lead to review the vendor's privacy terms.
Request a data privacy agreement if your school needs one.
Sign up for a free account or use single sign-on.
Create or pick a writing session.
Decide whether students will enter their names.
Share the join link with students.
Review the reports after the session.
